hero.title: Plan your wedding step by step, all in one place
hero.subtitle: Unlike vendor directories, tubodadiy brings your budget, guests, vendors, timeline and tasks together — with real tracking of your progress.

sections.title: 13 sections, one place
sections.description: Date, venue, guests, vendors, outfits, stationery, ceremony, timeline and much more, all in one place.

guests.title: Hassle-free guests
guests.description: Manage your guest list, RSVPs and dietary notes yourself, without relying on guests to use the website.

vendors.title: Organised vendors
vendors.description: Keep track of the booking status of every vendor: catering, photography, music, flowers...

budget.title: Budget under control
budget.description: Compare what you estimated with what you have spent in real time, by category and overall.

pace.title: Go at your own pace
pace.description: Jump between sections, mark some as done and skip others. That is how chaotic planning a wedding really is.

share.title: Share the plan
share.description: Invite your partner or your wedding planner with full access so you can plan it together.
